title: Supported cohomology as morphisms
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient ring $A=A_{E,n}$ of [def-pur-conventions].
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a
closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], with complementary
open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-open-immersion].
Work on the small pro-etale
sites with constant coefficient sheaves $A_T$ and ambient derived categories
$D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and let $i_*$ be
the underived module direct image [def-weil-proetale-module-direct-image].
For any bounded-below complex $F$ of $A_X$-module sheaves and every integer
$a$, there is an isomorphism, natural in $F$,
$$
H^a_Z(X,F)\;\cong\;
\operatorname{Hom}_{D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)}(i_*A_Z,F[a]),
$$
where the left side is the cohomology of derived supported sections
[def-pur-support-cohomology] and $i_*A_Z$ is placed in degree zero.
The shift uses the cochain convention $(F[a])^r=F^{r+a}$
[def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. No constructibility or finite-Tor
condition is imposed on $F$.

proof.text: Use the additive natural isomorphism between supported sections (after forgetting scalars) and Hom from the closed constant direct image. This is exactly the underived part of the original argument.

Exact scalar forgetting commutes with bounded-below right derived functors: both composites are right derived functors of the same homotopy-category functor, so uniqueness gives a natural isomorphism. Derive the underived natural isomorphism, then apply degree-a homology. Enough injectives and derived categories are the existing Grothendieck-abelian instances for module sheaves.

Apply the existing natural RHom roof comparison to the closed constant direct image in the ambient abelian category, and assemble its additive equivalences into a natural isomorphism. Compose with the previous comparison. This gives the asserted isomorphism for every integer a.

proof_origin.place: The original underived supported-Hom calculation, followed by right-derived uniqueness, exact scalar forgetting and the existing natural RHom roof comparison; implementation H2, 2026-10-19.
